quote: We conduct experiments on open-ended text generation, as well as on general language modeling benchmarks, comparing various performance metrics with and without applying auto-contrastive decoding.

Focusing on an open-ended auto-regressive text generation task, they show that it is possible to exploit the contrast between the predictions of the expert and amateur to obtain an improved generated output.

Generation quality is evaluated using automatic metrics focusing on different axes: aggregated n-gram diversity measures the repetitiveness within the generated continuations; semantic coherence estimates topic drift by calculating similarity between the prompt and continuation.
